integrity: All analytical claims have a reconstructed argument and exact rational interval checks for S_6; numerical matrix reconstruction is supplementary. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp powered-distance negative-type threshold and endpoint nullity are determined for the full-transposition metric on S_6. For S_n with n>=7 the theorem proves a decreasing representation-theoretic upper obstruction and factorial upper bound, not an exact generalized-roundness threshold or matching lower bound. An equivalent older formula is not excluded by the literature search.
title: A factorial negative-type obstruction for transposition Cayley metrics
